nodes.label: Mobile Expansion Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Approved design spec for additive tab extension, role-aware navigation, offline-first data layer, and new API controllers.

nodes.label: Mobile App Scope Redesign Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Approved design spec for scope-based navigation architecture with database-driven Scope model and ScopeShell.

nodes.label: Mobile App Enterprise Healthcare UI Redesign Spec
nodes.rationale: Approved spec for Teal Wellness palette, SVG section icons, assessment header spacing fixes, and mentorship detail reports-first tab.

nodes.label: Mentorship Sections Redesign Spec
nodes.rationale: Approved spec for splitting mentorship homepage into Ongoing/Upcoming/Closed sections with auto-close and duration labels.

nodes.label: MNCH Mentorship Platform
nodes.rationale: Laravel 12 + Filament v3 production web application for managing healthcare training and mentorship programs in Kenya.

nodes.label: Two Training Types Domain Split
nodes.rationale: Training model discriminates global_training (centralized MOH trainings) from facility_mentorship (on-site mentorships). Central architectural concept.

nodes.label: Kenya Geographic Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Division -> County -> Subcounty -> Facility. User access scoped via pivot tables county_user, subcounty_user, facility_user.

nodes.label: Spatie RBAC Roles
nodes.rationale: 15+ Spatie roles including super_admin, facility_mentor, mentee, etc. Permissions generated via Filament Shield.

nodes.label: Knowledge Base / Resources
nodes.rationale: Public resource center with public/authenticated/restricted visibility controlled by HasAccessControl trait.

nodes.label: Inventory / Commodities
nodes.rationale: Healthcare commodity inventory, batches, stock requests/transfers, low-stock alerts.

nodes.label: Analytics & Reporting
nodes.rationale: Filament widgets, controller dashboards, Kenya county heatmaps, monthly report generation.

nodes.label: Service Layer
nodes.rationale: Complex business logic centralized in app/Services/: TrainingAnalyticsService, AssessmentScoringService, EnrollmentService, etc.

nodes.label: Mobile API in Flux
nodes.rationale: Growing /api/v1 mobile API layer with known backend risks: conflict markers, enrollment rule mismatches, missing endpoints.

nodes.label: ScopeShell
nodes.rationale: Root navigation component that owns scope routing, hub rendering, and active scope header. Sits between App.jsx and feature screens.

nodes.label: ScopeHubScreen
nodes.rationale: Post-login hub showing role-allowed scope cards. Auto-skipped for 0/1 scopes; rendered for 2+ scopes.

nodes.label: Scope Model
nodes.rationale: Database-driven model storing slug, label, icon, color, gradient, tabs, is_active, sort_order for mobile feature scopes.

nodes.label: ScopeRoleAccess Model
nodes.rationale: Pivot model linking scopes to Spatie role names; controls which roles see which scopes.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/scope-config
nodes.rationale: API endpoint returning scopes allowed for the authenticated user, including visual config and summary stats.

nodes.label: AssessmentsScope
nodes.rationale: Isolated scope component for assessments with tabs home/assessments/reports/profile.

nodes.label: MentorshipsScope
nodes.rationale: Isolated scope component for mentorships; mentor tab set vs mentee tab set based on user roles.

nodes.label: TrainingsScope
nodes.rationale: Isolated scope component for trainings with tabs home/trainings/profile.

nodes.label: Role-Aware Bottom Navigation
nodes.rationale: Bottom nav tabs computed from user roles at login and persisted for offline use. Supports assessor, mentor, mentee, and admin tab sets.

nodes.label: Offline-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: Read flow tries network then falls back to IndexedDB cache; write flow optimistically updates local state and enqueues sync operations when offline.

nodes.label: IndexedDB Version 5
nodes.rationale: Adds mentorships, participants, myClasses, trainings, and attendance stores to existing mnch_offline database.

nodes.label: IndexedDB Version 7
nodes.rationale: Adds scopeConfig store to cache database-driven navigation configuration for offline use.

nodes.label: Sync Queue New Operations
nodes.rationale: Adds mentorship.module.start, mentorship.module.complete, mentorship.attendance.mark, and mentee.attendance.confirm operation types.

nodes.label: MentorshipController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller listing mentorships where the authenticated user is lead mentor or accepted co-mentor.

nodes.label: ClassModuleController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller for module lifecycle: list, start, complete, sessions. Delegates to ClassModule model methods.

nodes.label: AttendanceApiController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller for mentor attendance roster and manual/bulk marking via AttendanceService.

nodes.label: MenteeApiController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller for mentee class list, detail, and self-confirm attendance via AttendanceService.

nodes.label: ParticipantController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller returning class participants and per-mentee module progress.

nodes.label: GlobalTrainingController (API)
nodes.rationale: New API controller for MOH/national trainings list, detail, and participants.

nodes.label: Three-Section Mentorship Homepage
nodes.rationale: Homepage mentorship display split into Ongoing, Upcoming, and Closed stacked sections with distinct colors.

nodes.label: Ongoing Mentorships Section
nodes.rationale: Teal section showing mentorships where start_date <= now <= end_date, with Live Now badge and ends date.

nodes.label: Upcoming Mentorships Section
nodes.rationale: Green section showing mentorships with start_date > now, with starts date and duration chip.

nodes.label: Recently Closed Mentorships Section
nodes.rationale: Grey/muted section showing mentorships ended in the last 30 days.

nodes.label: AutoCloseMentorships Command
nodes.rationale: Daily Artisan command marking facility mentorships whose end_date has passed as completed.

nodes.label: Training Duration Label Accessor
nodes.rationale: getDurationLabelAttribute on Training model producing human-readable durations from days/weeks/months/years.

nodes.label: AssessmentAnalyticsService
nodes.rationale: New service encapsulating summary stats, insights, chart data, and facilities readiness queries for assessment analytics.

nodes.label: Facilities Readiness Table
nodes.rationale: Power table of latest assessed facilities with skills-lab eligibility, feedback status, and mentorship eligibility filters.

nodes.label: Assessment Feedback Tracking
nodes.rationale: Four new columns on assessments table: feedback_given, feedback_given_by, feedback_given_at, feedback_notes; managed via Filament action.

nodes.label: Facility Mentorship Breakdown
nodes.rationale: Drill-down page showing mentorships, classes, modules, and per-mentee attendance for a facility.

nodes.label: Teal Wellness Color Palette
nodes.rationale: Deep teal-to-cyan palette (#00565A, #0097A7, #26C6DA) chosen for maternal/child health feel and Africa-focused health platforms.

nodes.label: Indigo Sapphire Color Palette
nodes.rationale: Deep navy-to-indigo palette (#4F6AF5, #6C63FF) used in iOS Minimal redesign.

nodes.label: SVG Section Icons
nodes.rationale: Replace broken emoji icons with reliable colour-coded SVG icons for Infrastructure, Skills Lab, HR, Health Products, Info Systems, Quality of Care.

nodes.label: MentorshipOverviewScreen
nodes.rationale: New mentor landing screen after tapping a mentorship card: hero, stat pills, action strip, lazy class-mentee expand.

nodes.label: MyClassesScreen Redesign
nodes.rationale: Redesigned mentee screen with hero stat pills, inline module list, status icons, offline banner, and empty state.

nodes.label: MentorshipCard Stat Row
nodes.rationale: Enriched mentorship list cards showing mentees count, classes count, progress percentage, and progress bar.

nodes.label: Decision: Scope-Based Navigation
nodes.rationale: Chosen to prevent a cluttered flat bottom nav as feature areas grow; scopes are database-driven so access can change without code.

nodes.label: Decision: Teal Wellness Palette
nodes.rationale: Selected for maternal/child health feel, approachability, and prevalence in Africa-focused health platforms.

nodes.label: Decision: Indigo Sapphire Redesign
nodes.rationale: Chosen to move to Apple iOS Minimal aesthetic with Indigo Sapphire accent; pure styling, zero logic changes.

nodes.label: Decision: SVG Section Icons
nodes.rationale: Emoji icons broke rendering; SVGs are reliable, colour-coded, and align with the Teal Wellness redesign.

nodes.label: Assessment Analytics Dashboard Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Adds assessment mode as the first tab on the existing analytics dashboard so managers can see KPIs, charts, and a facilities readiness table with mentorship eligibility scoring without rebuilding the page.

nodes.label: MNCH Mobile App UI Redesign
nodes.rationale: Apple iOS Minimal · Indigo Sapphire direction chosen to give the field app a crisp, premium, native feel while keeping component structure and logic untouched.

nodes.label: Mentor & Mentee Dashboards Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Provides role-specific screens: mentors see filterable mentorship cards and a class-grouped mentee overview; mentees see enrolled classes with inline module progress.

nodes.label: Indigo Sapphire Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Primary #4F6AF5, secondary #6C63FF, hero gradient 1A1A2E to 2D3B8E, iOS system-grey #F2F2F7 background, SF Pro / -apple-system typography, 18px card radius, 50px pill radius.

nodes.label: Apple iOS Minimal Design Direction
nodes.rationale: Crisp white cards on iOS system-grey background, deep navy-to-indigo gradient heroes, one accent colour driving all interactive elements, native system font stack.

nodes.label: Hero Panel UI Pattern
nodes.rationale: Gradient hero panel with decorative radial-gradient orbs, glassmorphism stat pills, and rounded bottom corners; used on login, dashboard, and every screen header.

nodes.label: Frosted Glass Bottom Navigation
nodes.rationale: Frosted-glass bar with blur(20px) saturate(180%); active tab gets a filled indigo pill behind the icon plus indigo label.

nodes.label: Add Feedback Tracking to Assessments Migration
nodes.rationale: Adds four feedback columns to assessments: feedback_given boolean, feedback_given_by FK, feedback_given_at timestamp, feedback_notes text.

nodes.label: Skills Lab Derived Detection
nodes.rationale: Skills lab presence is derived at query time from assessment_section_scores joined to the skills_lab section, avoiding schema drift between responses and a stored boolean.

nodes.label: Mentorship Eligibility Logic
nodes.rationale: Eligible = assessed + skills_lab score > 0 + feedback_given; Partially Eligible = assessed + skills_lab score > 0 + feedback not given; Not Eligible = no skills lab.

nodes.label: Facilities Readiness Power Table
nodes.rationale: Read-only table with filters for county, skills lab, eligibility, feedback, and assessment type; columns include facility, level, latest assessment, skills lab, feedback, eligibility, and mentorship count drill-down.

nodes.label: Mark Feedback Given Filament Action
nodes.rationale: Backend-only action in AssessmentResource table; opens confirmation modal to collect optional notes and records who gave feedback and when.

nodes.label: Facility Mentorship Breakdown Drill-down Page
nodes.rationale: Full-page drill-down at /analytics/dashboard/facility/{facility}/mentorship-breakdown showing programs, classes, modules, sessions, attendance, and mentee roster.

nodes.label: Mentor Mentorship List Screen
nodes.rationale: Redesigned screen-mentorships-list with hero panel, All/Active/Completed/Draft filter pills, rich mentorship cards, progress bars, and a create FAB.

nodes.label: Mentee My Classes Screen
nodes.rationale: New screen-my-classes showing the mentee's enrolled classes with inline module status icons, progress bars, and attendance labels.
